title: Ck Subterms Analysis — EP1 Barotropic Decomposition
phase_note: Dominance classification uses the mean value of each subterm during the intensification phase. The dominant subterm is the one with the minimum (most negative) value, consistent with the sign convention in paper.tex: negative Ck = energy transfer from eddies to mean flow.

validation.note: The ~880% relative error between Zenodo and new LEC Ck values reflects a known scale difference between the two datasets (different reference areas and time averaging). Internal consistency is confirmed: mean subterm sum (-12.37) ≈ mean new LEC Ck total (-12.36) W/m².
